name: rankflow-block-ui
description: Rank Track Table View Extension — heatmap + Bộ key + Chạy ngay

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run typecheck && node scripts/test-owner.js
scripts.build: npm run check && webpack --mode production --config webpack.config.js
scripts.upload: STRICT=1 npm run build && opdev upload ./dist -t block -v $npm_package_version -d "Rank Track heatmap $npm_package_version"

rankTrack.note: identity comes from env (LARK_APP_ID, BLOCK_TYPE_ID, RANKFLOW_BASE_URL) - see ../.env.example
